title: Consciousness As Energy Transfer
definition: The concept that consciousness is an energy that is neither created nor destroyed, but merely transferred and modified.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine consciousness like a lamp that keeps shining even when you move it to a different place. Death isn't when the lamp goes out; it's just changing the lamp's location.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Consciousness is energy that follows conservation laws. It doesn't start at birth or end at death; it just changes its focus. The body is a temporary vessel for this energy.
difficulty_levels.expert: Consciousness as energy transfer challenges the notion of a permanent self. It suggests that our identity is a story told by others and can be dissolved when we're no longer remembered. This insight connects to the philosophy of non-duality and the nature of reality in physics.

extra_fields.insight: Consciousness is an energy transfer that challenges the notion of a permanent self.
